subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app 'Launch at login' stops sticking / appears to turn itself off after app updates

question: Should the macOS app persist OpenClaw-owned Launch at login intent and re-register `ai.openclaw.mac` after app updates when live launchd state drifts?
rationale: Current code treats live launchd state as authoritative, while the report expects user intent to survive app replacement/update; choosing differently can either restore user preference or override an intentional external disable.

options.title: Persist intent and reconcile drift
options.body: Store app-owned enabled intent and re-register only the app LaunchAgent after startup/update drift, with guards for deliberate external disablement.

options.title: Keep launchd authoritative
options.body: Treat macOS launchd/System Settings state as the source of truth and adjust the UI/docs so OpenClaw does not restore a disabled login item.

options.title: Wait for packaged repro
options.body: Keep the issue parked until a signed Sparkle update scenario proves which state flips before selecting repair behavior.

recommendation.title: Persist intent and reconcile drift
recommendation.body: Store app-owned enabled intent and re-register only the app LaunchAgent after startup/update drift, with guards for deliberate external disablement.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the custom LaunchAgent-backed checkbox path and is the strongest history-backed owner for the app state contract choice.
